transports.streamable-http: Default. Remote access via HTTP POST to / endpoint
transports.sse: Remote access via Server-Sent Events on /sse endpoint

cli_examples: python azure_pricing_server.py                                    # Streamable HTTP on localhost:8000
python azure_pricing_server.py --transport sse --port 9000        # SSE on port 9000
python azure_pricing_server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000      # Bind to localhost only

notes.remote: For remote transports, start the server before configuring clients
notes.paths: For stdio transport, update the 'cwd' path to match your actual installation directory
notes.python: Ensure Python is in your PATH or use full path to python executable
notes.virtual_env: If using a virtual environment, use the full path to the venv python executable
